About w Edinburgh Kitchen

W Edinburgh brings exciting new culinary destinations to the capital of Scotland. Situated on the 10th and 11th floors of the hotel, the spaces offer unrivalled panoramic view across the city, making it one of the most beautiful places in Edinburgh to dine.

Our signature restaurant is a partnership with SUSHISAMBA, which celebrates the culture and cuisine of Japan, Brazil and Peru. The menus are a mix of new and signature dishes with an emphasis on bold flavours, the finest ingredients and artful presentations.

W Lounge is W Edinburgh\u00e2\u0080\u0099s social hub for guests and locals alike. Open from 9am until late, W Lounge will showcase the best of Gaelic produce in its food offering, complimented with innovative beverage concepts.

Furthermore, there is innovative Breakfast, Room Service and Event menus. Supporting all aspects of the kitchen operation will give you the opportunity to find where your passion truly lies.

About The Role

Joining the team means you will be instrumental to the success of the hotel and the restaurant\u00e2\u0080\u0099s operation and beyond. We are looking for someone who is passionate about hospitality, eager to learn and committed to excellence!

As Kitchen Porter, key aspects of your role will include:

  • Operate and maintain cleaning equipment and tools, including the dish washing machine, hand wash stations pot-scrubbing station, and trash compactor
  • Wash and disinfect kitchen and store room areas, tables, tools, knives, and equipment
  • Receive deliveries, store perishables properly, and rotate stock
  • Ensure clean wares are stored in appropriate areas
  • Inspect, pull, and stack cleaned items, send soiled items back for re-scrubbing and re-washing
  • Clean and mop all areas in assigned departments

Our ideal Kitchen Porter is someone who has:

  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures
  • A warm, people-oriented demeanour
  • A team-first attitude
  • Protect company assets
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others
  • Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards

In return for your hard work, we give you:

  • World class training and development, including leadership development
  • Unlimited career opportunities (internationally and locally)
  • Wellness and mental health programmes
  • Discounted accommodation, food and beverage in over 9,000 hotels all over the world!
  • Discounts for your friends and family
  • Specially curated discounts in thousands of shops

About The Property

W Edinburgh brings bold architecture and a vibrant lifestyle offering to the Scottish capital. Behind a fa\u00c3\u00a7ade featuring a winding steel ribbon \u00e2\u0080\u0093 reflecting the city\u00e2\u0080\u0099s festival spirit \u00e2\u0080\u0093 this 12-storey structure is the centerpiece of Edinburgh St James Quarter, incorporating retail, leisure and entertainment facilities along with residential apartments.

This W hotel helps redefine the city\u00e2\u0080\u0099s hospitality landscape. Accordingly, it fuses the brand\u00e2\u0080\u0099s signature amenities with modern design and W Happenings, highlighting what\u00e2\u0080\u0099s new in design, fashion, music and culture.

Built in 2023, this new W hotel accommodates guests across 244 stylish guestrooms, including 45 suites. While staying here, guests benefit from the brand\u00e2\u0080\u0099s signature Whatever / Whenever service philosophy.

A real highlight of this property is its rooftop bar and outdoor terrace, pairing exciting cocktails and cuisine with 360-degree views over the historic city. Among the other noteworthy amenities are the W Lounge, a restaurant collaboration with SUSHISAMBA, a FIT workout facility and an AWAY spa, with special functions hosted in 2,450 sq ft of modern event space.
